Wham!'s "Last Christmas" vs Mariah Carey's "All I Want for Christmas Is You": on Nov 10, 2026, Wham! was already No.17 on Spotify's global daily chart, 312K streams a day ahead of Mariah at No.34.

2.28M daily streams for Last Christmas, 1.97M for All I Want for Christmas Is You. Wham! went from 18.5M to 21.8M monthly listeners between Nov 7 and Nov 12. But Mariah has spent 86 days at No.1 on the global daily chart. Wham!: 5.

So who owns Christmas, Wham! or Mariah?

Data: Spotify global daily chart via kworb, Spotify listeners · Nov 7-12, 2026
